:::

Malicious software (malware) deliberately designed to infiltrate, disrupt, or compromise digital systems and networks. Malware can be used for espionage, data theft, infrastructure disruption, or system degradation, serving both as a technical enabler and as a direct instrument of sabotage. It undermines operational continuity and public trust by exploiting the interconnectedness of critical digital environments.

:::
